summary: Frontend-only testing of Pivvix dark/light preview marketing concepts. All critical flows pass: routing (/ as dark, /preview/dark, /preview/light, 404 -> /), concept switcher (active state via aria-current, URL change, scroll-to-top after switch, browser back/forward), Nova state controls (listening/thinking/speaking update state label, speaker, caption, visual) with initial state = Speaking, competency selections (problem-solving, collaboration, strategic-thinking with insufficient-evidence state and no quote/timestamp), navigation anchors (#nova #intelligence #workflow, scroll-to-intelligence, footer-home-link returns to top), book-a-demo dialog from header/hero/closing with booking-preview-notice disclaimer and close via Back-to-preview / X / Escape, notes dialog from study strip and dock. Mobile menu toggles open/closed and closes on anchor click. No horizontal overflow at 1920/1440/768/390/320. Zero console errors or page errors. All interactive controls clickable without force=True at every tested viewport.

design_issues.screen: Hero / Nova preview card (both concepts, desktop ~1920)
issues: The floating 'Every conversation, connected.' evidence-float note is positioned so it visually overlaps the right edge of the 'Speaking' pill in the nova-controls row (more pronounced on Light Editorial where the overlay sits over the Speaking button rather than beside it). It does NOT intercept clicks (all nova-state-* buttons clickable without force at 1920/1440/768/390/320 and clicks succeed), but visually the pill is partially obscured. Consider shifting the evidence-float downward/outward on the Light concept so it clears the controls row.

action_items: Nice-to-have: Reposition evidence-float on Light Editorial so it no longer visually overlaps the Speaking control pill. (Non-blocking: clicks are not intercepted.)
critical_code_review_comments: App.js: scroll-to-top in useEffect runs on every pathname change including initial load — works correctly, but scrollY after Link switch was observed at 35 (not 0) because the fixed header's smooth scroll jitter; using behavior:'instant' already — acceptable, scroll is near top.
Dialog focus return handled correctly via onCloseAutoFocus + triggerRef.
All interactive elements have data-testid as declared in the spec; no missing testids were encountered during the full test sweep.
No API calls introduced; purely static illustrative content with SAMPLE DATA / ILLUSTRATIVE PREVIEW tags present as required.
Routes catch-all redirects unknown paths to /. Confirmed.
File sizes are small and focused; no DRY violations observed.
seed_data_creation: None (no backend / purely static demo data)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pure frontend marketing preview app with two concepts (dark/light). No backend tests needed. The only cosmetic observation is a slight visual overlap between evidence-float and the nova 'Speaking' pill — clicks still work. If main agent adjusts evidence-float positioning, simply re-screenshot /preview/light at 1920x1080 and /preview/dark at 1920x1080 and verify the Speaking pill is fully visible.
